cards.name: artistic1
cards.summary: CorelDRAW Artistic Media Brush stroke (category Artistic). Scripted render (the .cmx mapped along an S-curve), not Corel's own preview: chunky black rectangular dashes along the path, long and thick at the start, shrinking to small ticks at the end: a bold tapering dashed line.
use_for: route line on a sketch map
avoid: Even, technical dashed rules: the dashes shrink toward the end; use artistic34 or a dashed outline style.

Long paths: Brush mode stretches ONE copy of the artwork over the whole path, so dots and dashes stretch into ovals and bars; for evenly repeated marks use a Sprayer stroke or a dashed outline style instead.
cards.applies_to: An open path or curve (Freehand, Bezier, 2-point line or a converted outline); the brush artwork is stretched once along the whole path and the result stays linked to it as an Artistic Media group.
cards.how_to_apply: Select the curve, Artistic Media tool (I) > Brush on the property bar > Category: Artistic > Brush stroke: artistic1 (or Effects > Artistic Media docker). Script: import C:\Program Files\Corel\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite\25\Draw\CustomMediaStrokes\Artistic\artistic1.cmx, then map it onto the path with Curve.CreateCurveMappedToStroke(<path SubPath>, ...) as the gallery render did (a plain curve, not a live Artistic Media group).

verified.note: Chunky black rectangular dashes along the S-curve, thick and long at the start, shrinking to small ticks at the end.
